description: Defines the AutoCompleteRequest class used for constructing autocomplete query JSON objects, including methods for generating JSON strings and collection names based on merchant and language codes.

classes.name: AutoCompleteRequest
classes.description: Represents an autocomplete request with methods to generate JSON payload and collection name based on merchant and language codes.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representing an autocomplete query using the input query string.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Generates a collection name string based on keyword, language, and merchant codes.
